verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only general security features: user permission management, access control lists, audit logging and SAML SSO. None of it mentions restricting organization or repository access to an IP allowlist. One community user limits exposure by tunnelling over SSH, which is a user-side workaround and not a Gitea capability.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can restrict access to organization code to an IP allowlist
